claims.temporal_assessment: The record dates Army entry but does not identify an OSS start, transfer sequence, school or employer.
claims.match_notes: The matched private grade supports enlisted Army classification. The middle initial is an evidence-only name variant, not a correction to the index. The identifier remains private.

claims.claim_text: Vernon J Cook's printed identifier lies inside a NARA-documented missing serial-number range, so its absence from the merged Army file is inconclusive.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: NARA's technical table identifies a missing range that contains the index's private identifier; the bulk-file non-hit therefore cannot disprove Army service or identify an employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The index row remains unresolved; the missing-range evidence explains only why the official bulk file cannot test the printed identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The table documents data loss, not a service date, occupation, employer or OSS-accession sequence.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier is not exposed. Exact-name or similar public rows without the identifier remain unassigned.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 91 and complete Army literal-identifier and exact-name comparison; exact-name OSS/CIA, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, current Library of Congress, directory and archival checks for John E Cook.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The literal six-digit identifier has no Army-file match. Multiple exact-name Army rows carry other identifiers, and five Library of Congress pages concern different initials, professions or relatives.
research_attempts.research_notes: The identifier is not padded or reinterpreted. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
research_attempts.next_action: Interpret the identifier and distinguish candidates in Box 140.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 91 and complete Army exact-identifier comparison; Kenneth Cook and Kenneth W Cook variants; exact-name OSS/CIA, student, school, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, current Library of Congress, directory and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The Army row identifies only student status. A Kenneth H Cook Navy Department obituary is incompatible with the identifier-selected Kenneth W row, and no public source supplies the private identifier, school or OSS bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: Confirmed the exact-identifier Army identity and qualified student status; found no school or reliable pre-OSS employer.
research_attempts.next_action: Identify the school, study dates and Army-to-OSS chronology in Box 140.

research_attempts.next_action: Establish identity and pre-OSS chronology in Box 140.
